mandare.consejo: Regular verb of the first conjugation.

texto: The indirect object pronouns transform their final vowel **-i → -e** to the direct (* lo, la, li, le, ne *): **Ti mando il documento** → **Te lo mando**; **Mi presti la penna?** → **Me la presti?**; **Ci portate le chiavi?** → **Ce le portate?**.
«Gli» (to it) and «le» (to it) take the unique unified form **glie-** that fuses with the direct pronoun: **glielo**, **gliela**, **glieli**, **gliele**, **gliene**.

filas: Te lo mando stasera per posta elettronica.
I'll e-mail it to you tonight.
They bring them to us tomorrow morning.

frases.it: Hai inviato il riassunto dell'accordo a Lorenzo?
frases.es: ¿Has enviado el resumen del acuerdo a Lorenzo?
frases.en: Have you sent the summary of the agreement to Lorenzo?

frases.it: Gliel'ho già mandato ieri prima di uscire.
frases.es: Ya se lo envié ayer antes de salir.
frases.en: I sent it to him yesterday before I left.
analisis: I already sent it to him.

frases.it: E a me? Mi serve per la riunione con il direttore.
frases.es: ¿Y a mí? Me hace falta para la reunión con el director.
frases.en: What about me? I need to meet with the director.

frases.it: Te lo mando stasera per posta elettronica, tranquillo!
frases.es: ¡Te lo mando esta noche por correo electrónico, tranquilo!
frases.en: I'll send it to you by e-mail tonight, easy!
analisis: I'll send it to you tonight.

bloques.pregunta: Why does Elena say «Gliel'ho già mandato» when referring to Lorenzo?

opciones.texto: Because it combines the indirect «to him» (gli) with the direct masculine (lo) to the auxiliary verb.
opciones.explicacion: Grammatical explanation of the amalgam «glielo» elid to «ho».

opciones.texto: Because «gliel'ho» is only used when talking to women.
opciones.explicacion: False: «glie-» unifies both him and her.

opciones.texto: Because it means Lorenzo sent the document to Elena.
opciones.explicacion: Reverse the address of the document.

bloques.frase: Se hai finito la relazione, ___ invii per posta?

opciones.explicacion: «Mi» passes to «me» before the direct pronoun feminine singular «la».
Disadvised form that does not perform the required vocal mutation.
No orthographic error in the Italian pronominal system.

bloques.frase: Te lo mando stasera per posta elettronica.

opciones.texto: I'll e-mail it to you tonight.
opciones.explicacion: Precise translation of the combined pronoun and the temporary locution.

opciones.texto: I'll call you on the phone as soon as the meeting's over.
opciones.explicacion: It completely changes the promised action.

opciones.texto: I gave Lorenzo the printed paper at noon.
opciones.explicacion: It combines the recipients and places the action in the past.

bloques.pregunta: What form do «gli» and «le» take when they join the feminine plural «le» pronoun?

opciones.explicacion: «glie-» + «le» binding in a single graphic word.
It is prohibited to write separate third-person pronouns combined.
Agrammatical repetition outside the Italian verbal paradigm.

bloques.explicacion: Order the terms of the pronominal phrase.

bloques.frase: Non conosco il finale del libro: non ___ raccontare adesso!

opciones.explicacion: Link of the first person's indirect pronoun to the masculine singular direct.
It does not make the compulsory phonetic change from «mi» to «me».
It would change the addressee to a third person who is reflective or an alien.

bloques.pregunta: What is the right way for «They bring them to us tomorrow.»?

opciones.explicacion: «Ci» is transformed into «ce» at the feminine plural «le» direct.
It unduly retains the vocal -i in the indirect.
It would mean «They take them to themselves.».

intro: When daily favors, shipments or messages are communicated, the combined pronouns allow to link to who the action is intended and which object is delivered in a single agile sequence: **me lo**, **te lo**, **glielo**, **ce lo**, **ve lo**.
